scope: Newest-first ME5 Dhelmise three printings, including the identical MEP084 promo. Artwork and true BREAK excluded; older Garbodor cards not promoted.

ruleReferences.facts: Dhelmise Vengeful Anchor30+140 if own discard has4+Pokemon withHide n Sneak.
Garbotoxin removes discarded Abilities so no bonus; field-only Legendary Lava Cave leaves discarded Sinistcha counted.

evidence.name: Vengeful Anchor
evidence.textEn: If you have 4 or more Pokémon that have the Hide 'n' Sneak Ability in your discard pile, this attack does 140 more damage.
evidence.textZh: 如果自己弃牌区有4张及以上拥有特性「化隐」的宝可梦的话，则追加造成140伤害。
